description: Open the clustered motors rocket design at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/clustered_motors.ork in OpenRocket. This rocket needs a recovery system. Add a parachute component to the rocket by selecting the body tube in the component tree, then clicking the 'Parachute' button from the component palette (or using Add Component menu). Configure the parachute with a diameter of 60cm (600mm) and set the deployment event to 'Apogee'. After adding and configuring the parachute, save the modified design as /home/ga/Documents/rockets/rocket_with_recovery.ork using File > Save As.
